limitations: CAD nominal tensors with user mass overrides, not identified hardware dynamics.
Pi tower stationary components have no mass report. Base inertia is a known subtotal; base and wheel locks are mandatory.
Internal motor rotor and gear reflected inertia, friction, compliance and delay remain uncalibrated.
Pan race armature uses the whole-bearing inertia upper bound; sensitivity range is zero to this value.
ST3250 horns use closed mesh geometry and nominal aluminium density 2700 kg/m^3.
Each printed part is anchored locally. STEP occurrence placements and legacy motor/print assembly placements differ; no CAD global frame is used as world.
Existing robot joint axes, encoder zeros and collision geometry are retained; mass import does not certify their hardware accuracy.
